text: Security review at ed92c0ff7 found no confirmed critical/high issues and five actionable concerns. (1) MEDIUM: external_process_policy.cpp:153-215/370-380 treats PE CompanyName version metadata as publisher identity; WinVerifyTrust proves only some trusted signer, so compare the verified signer certificate/thumbprint instead. (2) MEDIUM: signature, CompanyName, and file identity are separate pathname opens at lines 153-215/363-392; replacement can bind authorization to bytes other than those verified, so retain one handle across checks. (3) MEDIUM: CopperfinStudioHostBridge.cs:476-518 uses CRT-style QuoteProcessArgument output inside cmd.exe /d /c for .cmd/.bat hosts; an unmatched quote plus cmd metacharacters in property/selector values can escape command quoting. Avoid command-text transport. (4) LOW: Windows empty allowed_path_roots fails open at external_process_policy.cpp:347, unlike POSIX line 416. (5) MEDIUM supply-chain: build-installers.yml:35-63 prefers existing/unversioned Chocolatey NSIS; only fallback is checksum-pinned, and these artifacts feed RC assembly. Always use or verify a pinned compiler. Known #5427 supporting-artifact check/reopen remains separately tracked. Local native security and managed language-service suites passed; native/security-supply-chain workflow contracts passed. Windows installer lifecycle contract was locally blocked by Snap PowerShell confinement, so Windows validation remains required.
